e2e.auth_notes: The actor is the seeded ADMIN user1, whose credentials come from the sample .env only.

db.notes: Creating category 'Sách thử nghiệm' with a description and no image inserts category id 16 (the dump seeds 15). The image field is left empty on purpose: an uploaded image is stored under a random temp-file name (ImageUtils.upload), which would make imageName volatile. category has no timestamps, so ignore_columns is empty. product_category and user are declared so a change outside the spec shows up.
